source: Cashew Value Chain Market Notes (sample, based on HEKS/EPER Cambodia Cashew Value Chain Assessment)
text: Most Cambodian cashew farmers sell raw, unprocessed nuts directly to local traders rather than to processors, because very little domestic processing capacity exists relative to production volume. This means farmers largely receive raw-nut export prices rather than the higher value captured by processing into kernels, and are often price-takers with limited bargaining power against traders. Joining a farmer group or cooperative, checking current raw cashew nut prices from multiple traders before selling, and timing sales to avoid the immediate post-harvest price dip (when supply is highest) can improve the price farmers receive.
